description: Start a run of a Foundry use case when the agent takes on a request. Pass the run's id as use_case_run_id to helix_foundry_read_graph, helix_foundry_ask, helix_foundry_send_pieces and helix_foundry_complete_document_upload while working on it: each records what it read or wrote under the run. Finish it with helix_foundry_finish_use_case_run and the agent's answer. A use case of origin workflow takes none: Foundry runs those.

client_token.description: At most 64 characters; the same token returns the run it started instead of starting another.

input.description: The run's initial request, as the agent was given it, at most 64 KiB. Optional here: send it with helix_foundry_finish_use_case_run instead.

use_case_id.description: The use case, as helix_foundry_create_use_case or helix_foundry_list_use_cases returned it.

workspace_id.description: Helix workspace identifier. May be empty when the caller has only one workspace (a service key always does).

name: helix_foundry_start_use_case_run

assessment.description: Its assessment, once it finished: how much what it read made its answer. A run that made no call to the ontology has none: it isn't assessed.

Untrusted, once done: the summary, the answer's claims (supported, unsupported or contradicted, with the calls' seqs that bear on them), the gaps the ontology had for the request, and suggested changes.

left_out.description: The calls whose results were left out to fit the model.

verdict.description: Once done: essential, helpful, marginal, unused or misleading.

from_workflow_run_id.description: For a run Foundry started: the workflow run it records (helix_foundry_get_workflow_run's run_id; its use case's workflow names the workflow). Not a use_case_run_id: this run's own id is id.

title: Start a use case run
